SELECT ?dept ?deptName

  uni:Marie_Dubois uni:worksIn ?dept .
  ?dept uni:belongsTo ?univ .
  ?univ uni:hasName ?deptName .
}
"""

    print(f"  Dept: {row.dept}, University: {row.deptName}")

PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
SELECT ?course
WHERE {
  ?course uni:isTaughtIn uni:Mathematics_Sorbonne .
}
"""

    print(f"  Course: {row.course}")

print("\n=== Currently enrolled in Math201 ===")
query3 = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema/>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?student uni:isEnrolledIn uni:Math201 ;
           uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?enrollDate .
  FILTER(?enrollDate <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
  OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
}
"""
for row in g.query(query3):
    print(f"  Count: {row.count}")

# Check what the full query returns for Marie Dubois specifically
print("\n=== Full query results for Marie Dubois ===")
query4 = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema/>

             uni:hasName ?professorName ;
             uni:role ?role .

  }
  
  {
    ?professor uni:worksIn ?dept2 .
    ?course2 uni:isTaughtIn ?dept2 .
    ?student2 uni:isEnrolledIn ?course2 ;
             uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?enrollDate .
    FILTER(?enrollDate <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
    OPTIONAL { ?student2 uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate }
    FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
  }
  
  FILTER(?professorName = "Marie Dubois")
}
"""
for row in g.query(query4):
    print(f"  Dept2: {row.dept2}, Course: {row.course2}, Student: {row.student2}")
